The preliminary build of all app binaries was omitted; each selected test target compiled normally.

@seelesturm thank you for asking. Yes: a read-only contributor pre-check may run during a collaborator review. The ownership guard (`.claude/skills/issue-claims/references/ownership.md`, "Only collaborator-authored reviewer records count") says that a contributor pre-check uses no reviewer record, no counted review marker and no review labels. Thus a pre-check takes no ownership. It does not have to verify our reviewer record, and the HTTP 403 from the collaborators API does not stop it.

The limits stay the same:
- Do not post a `<!-- pr-reviewer: ... -->` marker or an ownership record.
- Do not set review labels.
- Do not push to the branch while our reviewer record is active.

This PR merged at `abf9ebede`.
